quotes.text: This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: This is a Stripe-hosted page for when payment-ui is checkout and ui is stripe-hosted.
This is a Embedded form for when payment-ui is checkout and ui is embedded-form.
This is a Checkout Sessions API for when payment-ui is elements and api-integration is checkout.
This is a Payment Intents API for when payment-ui is elements and api-integration is paymentintents.
For these payment methods, the final payment status isn’t known when the `PaymentSheet` completes, and instead succeeds or fails later.

findings: The 2026-11-07 base-URL capture at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/accept-a-payment is a 20-line variant index (new:9-20), whereas the 2026-04-20 older capture contains the full hosted, embedded form, Checkout Sessions Elements, Payment Intents Elements, iOS, Android, and React Native guides (old:24,574,1201,2099,3198,4316,5225). The large deletion hunk in diff:3-6136 is a representation change at this captured URL; it does not establish API removal or deprecation.

Mapped source:14,16-23,84 presents '4 Web UI Modes' but its row for 'Embedded components' with ui_mode embedded_checkout is not a distinct variant in the matched old raw. The old web variants are Stripe-hosted page, Embedded form with ui_mode embedded_page, Checkout Sessions API with ui_mode elements, and Payment Intents API (old:24-28,574-578,611-613,1201-1207,1245-1261,2099-2105). Correct the source's taxonomy and keep the two Elements APIs distinct. The new index exposes hosted, full embedded page, and Checkout Sessions Elements links only (new:13-16); omission of the older Payment Intents link is not proof of deprecation.

Mapped source:32-40 labels three Checkout Session webhook events as generally key webhooks. Scope that table to Checkout Session flows; the older Payment Intents and mobile variants instead describe payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.processing and payment_intent.payment_failed (old:2822-2834,3794-3806,4813-4825,5769-5781). Checkout completion or a customer return is not a universal final paid-funds or fulfillment signal for delayed methods.

Mapped source:48 compresses Accounts v2 guidance into an unconditional recommendation for Connect. The old guide states Accounts v2 is generally available for Connect and public preview for other Stripe users, with a preview-version requirement for participating non-Connect users (old:1068-1078,2412-2418); keep those account/version conditions. The new index contains no account guidance.

Mapped source:60 names STPPaymentSheet and STPPaymentSheetConfiguration, while the older iOS integration instructs using PaymentSheet and PaymentSheet.Configuration (old:3203,3503-3505,3537-3543). Mapped source:65 says to hold a delayed-method order in pending state, whereas the old iOS/Android/React Native guide says the sheet result can precede final payment success and to inform the customer of order confirmation but fulfill only after payment succeeds (old:3723-3725,4811,5693-5695). Clarify UI acknowledgement, payment finality, and fulfillment separately.
substantive_changes: No new payment behavior is evidenced by the 2026-11-07 base-URL raw: it supplies navigation links only (new:9-20). The diff's removal of detailed guide text reflects the changed captured representation, not verified product or API removal.

A source summary correction is nevertheless material: correct its older four-variant web taxonomy, webhook scope, conditional Accounts v2 guidance, iOS API names, and delayed-payment status wording using the preserved dated old raw.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Keep the 2026-04-20 old raw reference and its dated hosted Checkout, embedded_page Checkout, Checkout Sessions Elements, Payment Intents Elements, and native PaymentSheet examples. Do not replace that factual raw_files entry with the navigation-only 2026-11-07 index.
Retain old guide distinctions between Checkout Session completion versus delayed asynchronous success/failure, and PaymentIntent succeeded/processing/failed event paths (old:213-232,2822-2834).

Retain the conditional saved-method rules for off-session setup_future_usage, optional payment_method_save consent and allow_redisplay, Customer v1 versus customer-configured Account v2, and card-only Checkout prefill (old:1030-1080).
Retain the mobile PaymentSheet qualification that a completed sheet can precede final status for delayed methods and fulfillment waits for payment success (old:3723-3725,4811,5693-5695).
conflicts: source:22's embedded_checkout mode conflicts with old:574-613 and old:1201-1261; the former is an embedded_page Checkout form and the latter is Elements with ui_mode elements.
source:65's pending-order wording is too broad relative to old:3723-3725, which distinguishes customer order confirmation, unknown final payment status, and later fulfillment.
unresolved_questions: The parameterized variant bodies linked in new:14-20 were not captured in this job. Their current API examples, version support, availability, and whether a Payment Intents variant remains linked elsewhere cannot be inferred from this index alone.

The new label 'Full embedded page' and query ui=embedded-page (new:15) differs from the older 'Embedded form' ui=embedded-form (old:574-576). This index alone does not prove a behavior rename or migration requirement.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/accept-a-payment, the new capture is a variant index, not a revised full integration guide: new:9-20 lists hosted Checkout, full embedded page, Checkout Sessions Elements, and three mobile routes. The older capture contains detailed web and mobile variants at old:24,574,1201,2099,3198,4316,5225. Therefore [[source-stripe-accept-a-payment]] should retain its dated older guide claims, and the missing Payment Intents link or old body text must not be treated as product removal.
answers.Q2: Queue a material correction to [[source-stripe-accept-a-payment]] for https://docs.stripe.com/payments/accept-a-payment even though the new:9-20 delta is navigation only. Its current source:16-23 invents a separate embedded_checkout web variant and obscures the older Payment Intents Elements path at old:2099-2105; source:32-40 needs Checkout-only webhook scope against old:2822-2834; source:48,60,65 need the old:1070-1078,3203,3723-3725 account, iOS API, and delayed-payment qualifications. Preserve both existing dated raw references and do not add this index as a factual guide.
